objective: Second diagnosis; conversion relevance rather than another offer ad
topic: “Do you deliver here?” as a repeated conversion obstacle
angle: Location uncertainty at the first decision
main_message: A verified coverage answer belongs where buyers decide
hook: “Do you deliver to my street?” should not be a guessing game.
